results.title: DevAlly: AI powered accessibility compliance for teams who ship fast | Product Hunt
results.content:
You describe the journey in plain English, something like "go to the contact page, fill out the form and submit it". DevAlly Agent walks through your site the way a user would. It handles things like cookie banners, asks you for sign-in details if it needs them, and records the journey. You review the steps, watch a replay of what it did and confirm it's right, because you know your product better than any AI does. There's a human in the loop all the way. [...] User journeys captured with natural language

Describe a user journey in plain English. The DevAlly Agent navigates your app and records a user journey, saving hours of engineering work. The DevAlly platform then audits each stage of journey against the WCAG criterion and suggests fixes for every issue. Constant changes, requires consistent accessibility monitoring. Our agent does it for you.

Free
